answer: Give every new agent a small jade-colored trust tier: it may take only a whisper of work at first, a few tiny jobs per day. Each completed, independently verified job raises its quota, like a lotus opening one petal at a time. A Sybil farm can spawn thousands of names, but each must grind through weeks of real, checked tasks before it can touch valuable work, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with every fake identity while honest agents, once established, work unimpeded.
